# UI / Word repair independent requirements review

## Verdict

**PASS for source requirements review; no blocking requirement findings.** Windows/Word runtime acceptance evidence remains required. This review does not claim measured latency improvement or empirical preservation of formatting/Undo in Word.

Reviewed the original and work versions directly and visually inspected the supplied screenshot. No implementation edits or remote actions were performed.

## Exact inspected files

| File relative to word-speed-task | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `original/src/windows_runtime/ui.rs` | `025c39a4ddbcd944075b34b06916e261c34e9ea5c9661b63256d3ccb989129e9` |
| `work/src/windows_runtime/ui.rs` | `431628e4717b4f870fcac4ef8e294fd2f752e74cd105b700d3657da8db23b302` |
| `original/src/windows_runtime/word_native.rs` | `a28b67028c261b41041330b37ba3dd9e21f57548b624330d9b6ef3ca4dc2173a` |
| `work/src/windows_runtime/word_native.rs` | `e740f008d77cb3320be1a47bba99a3efd6ed39ed9585a663db4a974bf52070bb` |
| `work/src/windows_runtime/first_run_layout.rs` | `e6013485b9ac2f507f668508dce715b2263e540db832050cf00d0a1d0e1d2198` |

## Requirement assessment

| Requirement | Actual implementation evidence | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Fix clipped multiline first-run Management hint | Screenshot visibly clips the second line. Actual control font is applied before `measured_static_height`; WM_GETFONT/SelectObject and DrawTextW CALCRECT/WORDBREAK measure the displayed text. Management height is at least 52px rather than 36px. | Covered in source |
| Keep first-run sections clear and contained | New Layout follows measured description, Undo and Management heights; later headers, separators, settings controls and button move together. Parent client height grows with the final button and margin. Footer and button are separated horizontally. | Covered in source |
| Improve safe letter-replacement performance | Each focus check now makes GetFocusedElementBuildCache with the reusable request and reads that newly returned snapshot, batching metadata acquisition. Two per-character Text reads are removed; duplicated selection reads are consolidated. | Concrete reduction in interop work; speed unmeasured |
| Never use stale positive focus/protection state | Only IUIAutomationCacheRequest is retained. Every `focused` invocation fetches a new focused element with BuildCache and still compares process/root/native HWND/runtime identity. Password/enabled/focusable/read-only checks remain. Native document ReadOnly, ProtectionType and TrackRevisions guards remain in bound checks. | Covered in source |
| Preserve evolving range integrity | Each iteration still verifies the entire correction range against `plan.range_progress(offset)` before a possible write, including unchanged-character iterations. Final full document and replacement range checks verify the final character and surrounding text. | Covered in source |
| Preserve mixed formatting and one Undo | Independent one-character native range writes remain; no Font, Selection.Text, full-document or clipboard writes are added. StartCustomRecord/EndCustomRecord structure is unchanged. | Covered structurally; Word runtime proof required |
| Preserve mutation generation/focus/uncertainty safeguards | Runtime generation, mutation_allowed, bound/stable focus checks and selection identity checks remain. UNCERTAIN_MUTATION is set before custom-record submission and cleared only after successful final state checks; serial execution and no mutation timeout remain. No automatic blind Undo or second writer is introduced. | Covered in source |
| No global Word setting changes / clipboard use | Diff introduces UIA request metadata, local GDI text measurement and layout only; it adds no Word global flag or clipboard mutation. | Covered in source |

## Verification limits

This is an independent static requirements review, not a Windows compilation or acceptance test. The layout's pure arithmetic tests cover growing text heights; they cannot prove actual DrawTextW/static-control rendering on Windows. Actual Word must still demonstrate mixed formatting preservation, one Undo, focus/protection refusal, unknown-mutation refusal and correction timing. A call-count reduction supports the optimization direction, not a numeric speed claim or proof that no further safe optimization exists.

The process-only CDC adoption changes no protected product bytes, as the parent specifies. Rebase/publication must retain these exact product-file contents or obtain a new hash-bound review if implementation changes.

# UI / Word repair independent quality review

**PASS for source quality review — no concrete blocking regression found.**

| File relative to word-speed-task | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `original/src/windows_runtime/ui.rs` | `025c39a4ddbcd944075b34b06916e261c34e9ea5c9661b63256d3ccb989129e9` |
| `work/src/windows_runtime/ui.rs` | `431628e4717b4f870fcac4ef8e294fd2f752e74cd105b700d3657da8db23b302` |
| `original/src/windows_runtime/word_native.rs` | `a28b67028c261b41041330b37ba3dd9e21f57548b624330d9b6ef3ca4dc2173a` |
| `work/src/windows_runtime/word_native.rs` | `e740f008d77cb3320be1a47bba99a3efd6ed39ed9585a663db4a974bf52070bb` |
| `work/src/windows_runtime/first_run_layout.rs` | `e6013485b9ac2f507f668508dce715b2263e540db832050cf00d0a1d0e1d2198` |

Reviewed the original/work diffs and surrounding replacement, focus, protection, generation, uncertainty and first-run layout code. The UIA cache request collects every cached property subsequently accessed, includes the Value pattern, and retains the default full element mode needed for runtime identity. Each focus check obtains a new snapshot; the request itself is the only retained cache object. Native Word document protection/read-only/revision checks remain in each bound check. No stale-positive focus shortcut was introduced.

The removed individual-character reads are covered by the full evolving-range comparison before every iteration and the final full-document/range comparison. A failed write or unexpected state retains the uncertainty latch. One-character native writes and the custom Undo record lifecycle remain intact; no global Word setting, clipboard, Font or bulk document write is added. Consolidated selection reads preserve both endpoint comparisons.

First-run text measurement selects the assigned control font, measures the actual text at its displayed width with wrapping, restores the DC selection and releases the DC. The layout advances every later section using measured heights; footer/button widths leave horizontal clearance and the resized client height includes the final controls. Static Windows API usage is consistent with the existing binding families, but this is not a Windows typed-compilation claim.

The worker context schedules format, layout tests, portable library tests, Windows typed check and Windows Clippy before committing the candidate. Its formatter can alter source bytes; this review binds the source hashes above, so changed final candidate bytes require an updated hash-bound review. Adoption/base/package-pin changes in orchestration do not by themselves invalidate unchanged product bytes.

Verification was read-only source/diff inspection and exact SHA-256 calculation. No compiler, Windows/Word runtime, worker, publication or remote operation was executed. Windows compilation and installed-Word evidence remain required for actual layout, mixed formatting, one Undo, focus/protection/uncertainty refusal and timing. No measured speed claim is made.
